card.name: Word endings in names and abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last piece of a name or abbreviation just before the next name or author part, such as the end of 'Furoate' or 'acetonide', or a period in an author citation like 'Pers.)'.

modes.label: Drug name endings
modes.description: The final piece of a drug name such as fluticasone furoate or fluocinolone acetonide.
modes.example: Fluticasone Furo<<ate>> ELLIPTA can produce paradox

modes.label: Taxonomic author citations
modes.description: Closing parenthesis or period inside a botanical author citation.

modes.label: Titles and inscriptions
modes.description: An alternate-title 'o' in a work title or letters inside an abbreviated Latin line.
modes.example: Álvaro,<< o>> La fuerza del sino

card.writes: It suppresses opening brackets and 'also known as' words, so it seems to discourage a parenthetical aside after the name.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a drug or species name, where a bracket or alias might otherwise follow.
